title: Looking for testers: I built a tool that enables AI to build, optimize AND run in live trading strategies.
author: mojovski
selftext:
I am looking for testers. DM if you are interested.  


**It can build:**

https://preview.redd.it/v9uqz4qxztoh1.png?width=859&format=png&auto=webp&s=d435986cac83bd1c0d63b98f986536d27a32a5fb

  
**It can extract and propose ideas from books and scientific articles:**

https://preview.redd.it/pi6bzdv30uoh1.png?width=666&format=png&auto=webp&s=cb511f3babb0ee49ee6f6c1251992d2e6f32446c

  
**It can optimize the first parameter guess by AI and measure the robustness:**

https://preview.redd.it/8ncai5kb0uoh1.png?width=935&format=png&auto=webp&s=8e32ca52c69ce8b455608f8c08d017a72228fe7d

  
It can provide deep statistics about a strategy:

https://preview.redd.it/xqau64tl0uoh1.png?width=1426&format=png&auto=webp&s=daba7c512482a4ae9df2ed708a1654ef7e1110e9

  
It can explain every trade entry and exit:

https://preview.redd.it/y51048cr0uoh1.png?width=939&format=png&auto=webp&s=0119fbbb888f3fc91b936ac951fe9c7b01d22d62

  
It can run the strategies in live mode

\- on virtual money

\- or connected to a MT account

https://preview.redd.it/jktr7k6x0uoh1.png?width=817&format=png&auto=webp&s=48c5842d2cf49e8e42211be6f4051bd8368e9d64

  
This week, it will be able to group strategies into portfolios of strategies and trade them live on an MT account as well.

  
If you are interested, DM me.

replies.author: mojovski
replies.body: For now only mt5 or mt4 are supported. Other brokers and platforms are on the roadmap.
